name: San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 18, 2024 -
05:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS – NONE
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the General Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval to waive the full reading of the text of all ordinances and resolutions introduced/adopted at this meeting. Ordinances and resolutions shall be introduced/adopted by title only. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve.
8B.
Approval of the Minutes of the November 20, 2024, Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2024-12-18 SDWD Item S08B Minutes
8C.
Approval of the Warrants List (Register of Demands). Contact Person: Finance Manager Dinh
Staff recommends that the Board review and approve the warrants.
2024-12-18 SDWD Item S08C SDWD Approval of Warrants List
8D.
Approval of changes to the calendar year 2025 San Dieguito Water District Board meeting schedule. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board of Directors, approval of the 2025 San Dieguito Water District Board Meeting Schedule, is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
Adopt Resolution 2024-24, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Approving the 2025 San Dieguito Water District Board Meeting Schedule."
2024-12-18 SDWD Item S08D 2025 Board Meeting Schedule
8E.
Notice of Completion of Public Water Improvements at 389 Requeza Street by Rancho Coastal Humane Society. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. The action involves acceptance of public water improvements and filing a Notice of Completion. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Alex
1) Accept the public water improvements; and 2) Authorize the General Manager to file a Notice of Completion.
2024-12-18 SDWD Item S08E Notice of Completion 389 Requeza
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS
To speak on action items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.
10A.
Award Construction Contract for the Air Release and Blow-off Replacement Project Phase I (CW23X). Environmental Considerations: It has been determined that the proposed project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301 (c) of the CEQA Guidelines. This section exempts projects characterized as minor alterations to public facilities, involving negligible or no expansion of the existing use. The Project is a water maintenance project and therefore, meets the criteria for this exemption. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Alex
1) Authorize the District Secretary to execute a contract in substantial form, and any necessary amendments and time extensions in consultation with the Agency Attorney, with Burtech Pipeline Inc., in the amount of $736,500, plus a 15 percent staff-authorized contingency ($110,475) for a total not-to-exceed construction contract amount of $846,975 including any future contract amendments for construction of the Air Release and Blow-off Replacement Project Phase I (CW23X); and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2024-25, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Amending the Fiscal Year 2024-25 Budget" to amend the FY 2024-2425 budget by transferring $382,500 from Project No. CW23D Water Transmission Line Maintenance and $382,500 Project No CW23C Water Infrastructure Improvements, to fund Project No. CW23X, Air Release and Blow-off Replacement Project Phase I ("Project").
2024-12-18 SDWD Item S10A ARV & BO (CW23X) to Burtech
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS – NONE
To speak on informational items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.
S12.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S13.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
13A.
General Manager Update/Report
S14.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR BOARD MEETING WILL BE HELD ON JANUARY 22, 2025
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
